data.name: PrivacyBody
data.value:
Data controller
Charles Nicollas, site publisher (see Contact in the footer).

Data collected

  • A login chosen at registration.
  • An email address, stored encrypted and used only for registration confirmation, password resets and email changes.
  • A password, never stored in plain text (hashed).
  • The IP address at registration, for fraud and multi-account prevention.
  • Game history (guesses, scores, badges).

Purposes
This data is used exclusively for the game to function (accounts, leaderboards, badges) and for service security (fraud prevention, password resets). It is never sold, shared with third parties, or used for advertising.

Legal basis
Performance of a contract (providing the service) for account data, legitimate interest for fraud prevention.

Retention period
Data is kept for as long as the account exists. Deleting the account deletes the associated data.

Your rights
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to, and port your data. You can exercise these rights via the Contact link in the footer.

Security
The email address is encrypted in the database, passwords are hashed (never stored in plain text), and account access requires authentication.

data.name: CookiesBody
data.value:
The site only uses cookies strictly necessary for it to function:

  • an authentication cookie, to keep you signed in;
  • a language preference cookie.

No analytics, advertising or tracking cookies are used. In accordance with regulations, these strictly necessary cookies do not require prior consent.
